title: Baseline BACnet/IP Who-Is discovery
purpose: Provide a compact unconfirmed discovery seed that exercises BACnet/IP BVLC plus NPDU plus APDU parsing before any confirmed service interaction.
expected_behavior: Target accepts an unconfirmed discovery request and may respond separately with an I-Am message if configured to do so.
constraints_preserved: BVLC function 0x0b used with four-byte total length 0x000a
NPDU retained as a minimal routed-free control form
APDU high nibble 0x10 preserved for Unconfirmed-Request-PDU
Service payload kept minimal to avoid undocumented field speculation
issue_safety_notes: No oversized lengths, nested tags, or issue-triggering property-value payloads are used.
